# Quality strategy

> **What:** how we know Campaign Planner is good enough: targets, checks, who judges, and the risks we accept
> **Read when:** planning checks for a change, or deciding whether something is ready to ship

## 2. Checks and who runs them

- Runner: typecheck and lint on every task; build and all tests at Check.
- Person: a planner tries every calendar change on a desktop screen before it is verified.
